title: 3D Cross Totem
description: A Resource pack that replaces the vanilla Totem of Undying with a beautifully detailed 3D Cross. Perfect for christian players :P.
body:
# ✝️ 3D Cross Totem of Undying

A clean and elegant resource pack that replaces the vanilla **Totem of Undying** with a beautifully detailed **3D Cross**. Perfect for clean setups, PvP packs, or medieval/cozy fantasy aesthetics. Also if you are a proud crhistian :P

![In game look of the item in hand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25830595f121ca7e25caa0aa365b1c12d7ddd016.png)
---

## ✨ Features

* **3D Hand & Ground Model:** Hold a fully detailed 3D Cross in either hand.
* **2D Clean Inventory Icon:** Keeps your hotbar and inventory clean with a custom 2D sprite so it doesn't clutter your UI.
* **📦 Punchy Mod Compatibility:** The Model will display in your punchy hands.
* **Optimized & Lightweight:** Zero lag, designed following the modern Minecraft item formats.

---

## 🔧 Installation & Requirements

1. Download the `.zip` file.
2. Drop it into your `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` folder.
3. Activate it in-game (**Make sure to put it at the very top of your Resource Packs list** so it overrides any other totem models!).
4. *(Optional)* Use the **Punchy Mod** if you want a better game feel for the cross item.

---

## 🛠️ Technical Details

* **Format:** Modern Modern Item Components (`items/` folder config).
* **Compatibility:** Minecraft 26.2 (Tested and fully functional on latest versions).
* **Credit:** Model created using Blockbench.

*Feel free to report any visual bugs or suggest position tweaks in the comments!*

Textures and Model By Juanjomacartur
